name: Wizard OS install snapshot 0.3.35
about: 0.3.34 plus Agent Service 039eff5: wizard-agent-service #141 (Setup 'Use Wizard on your phone' shows the box's private tailnet link on alongside boxes that run host Tailscale without the private-access helper) and #142 (the owner's own Wizard message shows and the 'Sent / Dismiss' bubble clears: Hermes 0.22.5 stamps admitted API turns internal_notification). Every other pin unchanged.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.

wizard-troubleshooter.note: Host tooling, no image: installed by `wam troubleshooter` as user systemd units (wizard-troubleshooter.service + wizard-guardian.timer, report-only) from exactly this commit; c434bbe plus #9 (connection app links follow apps.json; no dead Claude button when Claude Code is missing).

wizard-agent-service.note: Official main merge 039eff5 (#141, #142); public multi-arch image published.

wizard-ux.note: Official main merge 788affe; newest commit whose public multi-arch image published successfully (24 Oct 04:45 UTC).

wizard-app-manager.note: Official multi-arch image built from db4325a; its image_inputs are unchanged at the pinned component commit 0f8a58b.

shell.note: Alongside installs use the immutable official image above; index drift is informational.

ai-connection.note: Host Hermes owns and renews its sign-in; the connection app reads sanitized usage through the wizard-os dashboard plugin. Claude is installed by default as its own `claude-subscription` row below.

claude-subscription.note: Installed on every box next to ChatGPT. Alongside with host Hermes on a claude-subscription provider: App Manager binds the agent's own Claude Code login folder at the engine's /claude, so Connect/Test and auto-renew act on the agent's sign-in; tokens are never copied.

secrets.note: secret-drop #1: the engine image is pinned by its multi-arch digest (secret-drop:0.1.1@sha256:29ebc6a7…c03302), the same bytes as the 0.1.1 tag in 0.3.19.

hermes.test_record: none: carried over from 0.3.21, pinned before Wizard stable existed
